answer: Each identity is minted by burning 50 units into an onyx-black public burn ledger, a permanent receipt no one can fake or reuse. The burn is the ember that lights one identity: no burn, no trading rights, and the receipt must be renewed with a 5-unit burn every 8 epochs. Burns are irreversible, so an attacker pays real money for every fake and cannot recycle it. A cheat loses its opal-clear standing plus the bond posted beside the burn, so 100 fakes burn 5,000 units plus 500 renewal units per cycle before earning a single trade.
